payload.title: Candidate trading on own candidacy contract
payload.description: The CFTC advisory reports that Kalshi investigated a political candidate trading on his own candidacy and imposed disgorgement, a penalty, and a suspension.
limitations: The advisory identifies neither an exact market ticker nor an account identifier.
The advisory states only that the activity occurred in May 2025; the full-month window is approximate.
This public case cannot be joined to transaction-level data without additional authoritative mapping.

payload.rationale: The advisory does not identify the market or transaction timestamps needed to adjudicate a detector window.
The advisory does not establish a point-in-time public-information archive around the trades.
The advisory reports an acknowledged direct-influence rule violation and venue sanctions; exact account mapping remains unavailable.

payload.title: Affiliated YouTube editor trading channel-related contract
payload.description: The CFTC advisory reports that Kalshi found a channel editor likely had advance knowledge of video contents, concluded there was reasonable belief of misappropriated nonpublic information, and imposed disgorgement, a penalty, and a suspension.
limitations: The advisory identifies neither an exact market ticker nor an account identifier.
The advisory states only that trading occurred in August and September 2025; the two-month window is approximate.
This public case cannot be joined to transaction-level data without additional authoritative mapping.

payload.rationale: The advisory does not identify the market or transaction timestamps needed to adjudicate a detector window.
The advisory does not provide an immutable publication timeline or exact trade timestamps.
The advisory reports venue findings of affiliation, likely advance knowledge, reasonable belief of misappropriation, and sanctions; exact account mapping remains unavailable.
